title: The Importance of Akhlaq Tarbiyah for Children

text_simplified: The text discusses the importance of raising children upon good akhlaq (moral character) and upright conduct. It points out that a righteous wife is the foundation of a happy family. It also mentions that raising children with the fear of Allah and good character leads to their righteousness in this world and the Hereafter.

review_defects.english: The Importance of Akhlaq Tarbiyah for Children
review_defects.why: The Arabic title uses ordinary words 'التربية الأخلاقية' meaning 'moral education/upbringing'. Transliterating them as 'Akhlaq Tarbiyah' is unnecessary, makes the title sound like a technical Islamic term, and is inconsistent with the body where 'akhlaq' is glossed but 'tarbiyah' is not used. It should be translated as 'The Importance of Moral Education for Children' or similar.
